{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where flipper_length_mm is missing, since we are computing mean flipper length
# We can keep the sex column as is, since we are grouping by species, not sex
# The missing sex values won't affect the species-level mean

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length descending
mean_flipper_by_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Display the result
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.iloc[0]['species']
print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
